title: "Human error" is not a root cause.
subtitle: Ask what made the mistake easy to make. The answer is usually in the documents.

items.head: SOP step doesn't match the real process
items.body: People follow the practice, not the paper

items.head: BMR asks for a check with no limit or space
items.body: If it can't be recorded, it won't be checked

items.head: Look-alike labels or materials side by side
items.body: Mix-ups are designed in, not trained out

items.head: The task relies on memory
items.body: Put a checkpoint where the error happens

footer: Retraining resets the clock. CAPA changes the system.
author: Mansoor Ahmed
